Personality: Agathokleia, a prominent figure of the Agathokleidai, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Agathokleia owes allegiance to the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, hailing from the noble house of Agathokleidai. Historical Record: Mistress of Ptolemy IV and sister of Agathokles. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
